points.description: The student obtains a perimeter of 52 cm with every step valid. The working must correctly find the top base as 11 cm from the area formula (162 = ½(16 + top base) × 12), find the slanted side as 13 cm (horizontal offset 16 − 11 = 5, vertical height 12, so √(5² + 12²) = 13), and add 16 + 11 + 12 + 13 = 52. Equivalent methods and wording earn the mark. Any wrong step, or a wrong final answer, earns 0.

rubric.notes: The mark is all-or-nothing, as the model answer requires every step to be valid and the final answer to be correct. Full marks go to a student who reaches 52 cm through valid steps, whatever method or wording is used. Partial credit is not available, so a wrong step or a wrong final answer earns no mark.
